mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,callback_id,idempotency_key,command_data,status,revision,created_at,updated_at FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_registrations WHERE tenant_id=#{ref.tenantId.value} AND callback_id=#{ref.callbackId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,delivery_id,callback_id,command_digest,input_id,envelope_data,status,revision,attempt, reason_code,audit_ref,lease_claim,lease_worker,lease_token,lease_until,available_at,recorded_at,updated_at FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=#{ref.tenantId.value} AND delivery_id=#{ref.deliveryId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_execution_workflow_callback_deliveries b JOIN agent_runtime_execution_waits w ON w.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND w.run_id=b.run_id AND w.action_id=b.action_id AND w.generation=b.generation WHERE b.tenant_id=#{ref.tenantId.value} AND b.delivery_id=#{ref.deliveryId} AND b.input_id=#{envelope.inputId.value} AND b.run_id=#{target.owningRunRef.runId} AND w.kind='WORKFLOW' AND w.input_id=b.input_id AND w.response_ref IS NOT NULL AND w.execution_id=#{target.executionRef.executionId} AND w.action_key=#{target.actionKey} AND w.execution_revision=#{target.expectedExecutionRevision})

SELECT tenant_id, callback_id, idempotency_key, command_data, status, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_registrations WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_callback_registrations (tenant_id, callback_id, idempotency_key, command_data, status, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{callbackId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{commandData}, #{status}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT command_data, output_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_registration_operations WHERE AND callback_id = #{id} AND operation_id = #{operation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_callback_registration_operations (tenant_id, callback_id, operation_id, command_data, output_revision) VALUES (current_setting('app.tenant_id'), #{id}, #{operation}, #{command}, #{revision})
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, delivery_id, callback_id, command_digest, input_id, envelope_data, status, revision, attempt, reason_code, audit_ref, lease_claim, lease_worker, lease_token, lease_until, available_at, recorded_at, updated_at FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_deliveries WHERE tenant_id = #{ref.tenantId.value} AND delivery_id = #{ref.deliveryId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id, delivery_id, callback_id, command_digest, input_id, envelope_data, status, revision, attempt, reason_code, audit_ref, lease_claim, lease_worker, lease_token, lease_until, available_at, recorded_at, updated_at FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_deliveries WHERE AND ( (status = 'READY' AND available_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY available_at, recorded_at, delivery_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_callback_deliveries (tenant_id, delivery_id, callback_id, command_digest, input_id, envelope_data, status, revision, attempt, reason_code, audit_ref, lease_claim, lease_worker, lease_token, lease_until, available_at, recorded_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deliveryId}, #{callbackId}, #{commandDigest}, #{inputId}, #{envelopeData}, #{status}, #{revision}, #{attempt}, #{reasonCode}, #{auditRef}, #{leaseClaim}, #{leaseWorker}, #{leaseToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{availableAt}, #{recordedAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.agent_runtime_callback_deliveries SET status = #{row.status}, revision = #{row.revision}, attempt = #{row.attempt}, reason_code = #{row.reasonCode}, audit_ref = #{row.auditRef}, lease_claim = #{row.leaseClaim}, lease_worker = #{row.leaseWorker}, lease_token = #{row.leaseToken}, lease_until = #{row.leaseUntil}, available_at = #{row.availableAt}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{row.deliveryId} AND revision = #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT command_data, output_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_callback_delivery_operations WHERE AND delivery_id = #{id} AND operation_id = #{operation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_callback_delivery_operations (tenant_id, delivery_id, operation_id, command_data, output_revision) VALUES (current_setting('app.tenant_id'), #{id}, #{operation}, #{command}, #{revision})
mapper.select: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_callback_audits (tenant_id, resource_kind, resource_id, command_digest, audit_ref, reason_code) VALUES (current_setting('app.tenant_id'), #{kind}, #{id}, #{digest}, #{audit}, #{reason}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_kind, resource_id, command_digest) DO UPDATE SET audit_ref = agent_runtime_callback_audits.audit_ref RETURNING audit_ref
